articles.title: BofA Awards $1 Million to Rebuild Pacific Palisades YMCA Destroyed in Wildfires
articles.mainIdea: BofA Awards $1 Million to Rebuild Pacific Palisades YMCA Destroyed in Wildfires
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BofA Awards $1 Million to Rebuild Pacific Palisades YMCA Destroyed in Wildfires. In recognition of the one-year anniversary of the Los Angeles wildfires, Bank of America announced a $1 million grant to the YMCA of Metropolitan Los Angeles to help rebuild the Lowe Family YMCA serving the Palisades-Malibu community that was destroyed by the fires. The BofA grant is the first and largest corporate award to date for the YMCA's $25 million capital campaign that was launched over the summer. articles.mainIdea: Invitation to media and analyst briefing for Ericsson Q4 2025 report
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Invitation to media and analyst briefing for Ericsson Q4 2025 report. Ericsson's (NASDAQ: ERIC) financial report for the fourth quarter 2025 will be published at approximately 7:00 AM CET on January 23, 2026. The company will issue a press release with the complete financial report attached, including tables, in PDF format. Following publication of the press release, the financial report will be available on Ericsson's website: https://www.ericsson.com/en/investors Related tickers mentioned: ERIC, ERIXF.
